mentions.name: Kumi
mentions.description: Kumi is a typed, array-oriented dataflow compiler that takes small declarative schemas and emits plain Ruby and JavaScript, with a C path. Its mid-end implements inlining, common subexpression elimination, constant folding, dead code elimination, loop fusion, and LICM. A web demo is available to try it out.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building a typed, array-oriented dataflow compiler that takes small declarative schemas and emits plain Ruby and JavaScript, with a C path. It has a mid-end with inlining, common subexpression elimination, constant folding, dead code elimination, loop fusion, and LICM.
